MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Samuel K. Feng, Esq. appeared with plaintiff John Russ, who was placed under oath and examined.
No appearance by defendant James Kasey.
Default was entered against defendant on April 2, 2008.
Doe defendants were dismissed on May 13, 2009.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff John Russ, and against the Defaulted Defendant James Kasey as follows:

Damages/Principal - $64,500.00.
Prejudgment Interest - $0.00.
Attorney's Fees - $0.00.
Costs - $518.00, for a total judgment in the amount of $65,018.00.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
